title: Brazilian Crunchy Hash
description: A crispy and flavorful hash dish inspired by Brazilian cuisine, with a crunchy texture from the available ingredients.
instructions: In a pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Add the Brazilian Hash and cook until golden brown.
Add the Crunchy Tadka to the pan and stir well.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add the Garlicky Hash and cook until crispy.
Combine the cooked Brazilian Hash and Crunchy Tadka mixture into the pan with the Garlicky Hash.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
